Figure 3. Structural evolution of n-Li2SiS3 (tetragonal, P42212) to e-Li2SiS3 (orthorhombic, Cmc21) with increasing temperature. The intermediate m-Li2SiS3 consists of n-Li2SiS3 and e-Li2SiS3. with increasing temperature. The XRD patterns recorded during the phase evolution of n-Li2SiS3 with increasing temperature are shown in Figure S3. In the case of n-Li2SiS3, two (Si/P)S4 tetrahedra link across a common edge to form (Si/P)2S6 dimers. The n-Li2SiS3 framework is composed of these dimers and diﬀers from that of e-Li2SiS3, which is formed by inﬁnite corner-shared SiS4 chains.16 It is speculated that the isolated dimers open to form linked chains at high temper- atures. The framework of n-Li2SiS3 has a 3D lithium conduction pathway (2D in the ab plane +1D along the c- axis).
